texts.content: To bind Bagdana, king of the demons and great lord of the liliths. The spell adjures Lilith Hablas, granddaughter of Lilith Zarne, orders her struck and expelled, gives her a divorce, and drives her from the house of Aspa son of Hoba and his wife, daughter of Immi.
